Aurea 1.0.9 (2234)
• Redesigned home, add menu, effects browser, and export flow.
• Community filters, sorting, and official announcements.
• Compact graph controls on tablets and a customizable grid.
• Vector masks, Time Remap in Effects, and more particle options.
• 3D Repeater, Toon Material, and add-ons for the 3D workspace.
• Improved 360° sky, contact shadows, and foliage cutouts.
• More editable effects when importing After Effects projects.
• Fixes for the timeline, audio, touch controls, and export.
